mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_CODE, COMPANY_NAME, CEO_NAME, ADDRESS, PHONE FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

AND c.COMPANY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{companyName} || '%'
